newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cardoso to visit Britain, Italy.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cardoso to visit Britain, Italy.

text.p: Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso will visit Britain from February 9-10 and then Italy, where he will have an audience with Pope John Paul, the Foreign Ministry said on Thursday.
The ministry said Cardoso would hold talks with British Prime Minister John Major and would address a conference on Latin American economies entitled "The Link into Latin America".
In Italy, the Brazilian leader was scheduled to spend a day in Rome and visit the Vatican on February 14.
